title: Proverbs Bible Quiz - Chapter 11
description: Ten questions on Proverbs 11: honest weights, humility and pride, generosity, and the fate of those who trust in riches.

questions.text: What is an abomination to Yahweh in the first verse of this chapter?
questions.explanation: A false balance is an abomination to Yahweh, but accurate weights are his delight.

questions.text: According to this chapter, what comes with humility?
questions.explanation: When pride comes, then comes shame, but with humility comes wisdom.

questions.text: What does one who brings gossip do, in contrast with one of a trustworthy spirit?
questions.explanation: One who brings gossip betrays a confidence, but one who is of a trustworthy spirit keeps a secret.

questions.text: Where is there victory, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: Where there is no wise guidance, the nation falls, but in the multitude of counselors there is victory.

answers.text: In the strength of the king
In the hand of the diligent

questions.text: What is a beautiful woman who lacks discretion compared to?
questions.explanation: Like a gold ring in a pig's snout is a beautiful woman who lacks discretion.

answers.text: A gold ring in a pig's snout

questions.text: What does this chapter say about the one who scatters?
questions.explanation: There is one who scatters and increases yet more, and one who withholds more than is appropriate but gains poverty.

questions.text: How does the saying continue: "He who waters shall..."?
questions.explanation: The liberal soul shall be made fat, and he who waters shall be watered also himself.

questions.text: Whom do people curse, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: People curse someone who withholds grain, but blessing will be on the head of him who sells it.

answers.text: Someone who moves a boundary stone

questions.text: What happens to him who trusts in his riches, in contrast with the righteous?
questions.explanation: He who trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous shall flourish as the green leaf.

answers.text: He will wither in the heat

questions.text: What shall he who troubles his own house inherit?
questions.explanation: He who troubles his own house shall inherit the wind, and the foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart.
